input.text: Check deposits over $6,000 in one day are eligible for an extended hold on the amount over that figure. Checks deposited to a new account may be held for up to 7 business days.
sources: Check deposits over $6,000 in one day are eligible for an extended hold on the amount over that figure.
Checks deposited to a new account may be held for up to 7 business days.

input.text: Provisional credit is issued within 10 business days of receiving a completed dispute.
sources: Provisional credit is issued within 10 business days of receiving a completed dispute.
Customers have 60 days from the statement date to dispute a debit card transaction.

input.text: Each item paid into overdraft is charged $30. Accounts that remain overdrawn for 45 days are referred for charge-off. Personal bankers may waive service fees up to $15 per account in a calendar year.
sources: Each item paid into overdraft is charged $30.
Accounts that remain overdrawn for 45 days are referred for charge-off.

input.text: No overdraft fee is charged when the account is overdrawn by $10 or less at the end of the day, where appropriate. Each item paid into overdraft is charged $30, where appropriate.
sources: No overdraft fee is charged when the account is overdrawn by $10 or less at the end of the day.
Each item paid into overdraft is charged $30.

input.text: Customers may request a fee refund within 60 days of the statement date. Customers may request a fee refund within 30 days of the statement date. A personal banker can waive no more than $25 for one account in a calendar year.
sources: Customers may request a fee refund within 60 days of the statement date.
In Colorado branches, customers may request a fee refund within 30 days of the statement date.
A personal banker can waive no more than $25 for one account in a calendar year.
